title: Sort List
statement: Sort a linked list given as values and return the sorted values. Use merge sort on the nodes: split with slow and fast pointers, sort both halves, and merge.
hints: The fast pointer starts one node ahead of slow so the split leaves the midpoint on the left half.
Cut the list at slow.next before recursing, or the two halves stay connected.
The merge is the same as merging two sorted lists: pick the smaller head and advance that list.

approaches.name: Copy into an array and sort
approaches.explanation: Easy and not the linked-list exercise.

editorial: A list of length 0 or 1 is sorted. Otherwise find the middle, detach the second half, sort both halves, and merge them by always taking the smaller current node. The recursion depth is logarithmic because the split is even.
